premise.claim: A few RoleBasedGroup admission requests still fail (connection refused / timeout) at the moment an old manager Pod is deleted, because on SIGTERM the manager stops the webhook server on :9443 at once while the API server keeps routing until the endpoints drop the Pod; every RBG webhook has failurePolicy: Fail (issue #583).
premise.reportedComponent: controller manager Deployment / webhook serving (deploy layer)
premise.patchedComponent: manager Deployment in config/manager, deploy/helm/rbgs, deploy/kubectl/manifests.yaml
premise.evidence: Base manager Deployment has lifecycle=None and no terminationGracePeriodSeconds (results/base-absence.out); the PR's own drain tests FAIL on base with 'want an exec preStop hook, got lifecycle nil' (results/base-chart-drain-tests.out); vendored controller-runtime v0.22.1 calls srv.Shutdown on SIGTERM, closing the webhook listener immediately (results/shutdown-codepath.out). All 6 webhooks in both install paths are failurePolicy: Fail. The live frequency (1/2341 requests) is author-measured; the live layer was skipped per round instructions.

findings.title: Manager Deployment carries exec preStop /bin/sleep 5 and grace >= 35s in chart and kustomize base (PR's own tests)
All three shipped install surfaces (helm render incl. value variants, config/manager, deploy/kubectl/manifests.yaml) satisfy the drain contract
deploy/kubectl/manifests.yaml is byte-identical to kustomize build config/default (regeneration claim)

liveNote: L3 (skipped this round per instructions): on kind, install via helm and via deploy/kubectl/manifests.yaml, send server-side dry-run RBG creates every ~75ms while running kubectl rollout restart deployment/rbgs-controller-manager, and count failed calling webhook errors; expect 0 over >=5 rollouts per path (author's measurements: 0/2820 helm, 0/5662 kubectl on the PR head).
